_about: Pillar 2 shelf-life and safety assumptions. FSSAI-guided, NOT FSSAI-certified. Values are conservative demo assumptions for an Indian college canteen (sealed = as delivered / uncut, opened = pack opened or produce cut). A real kitchen must replace them with its own supplier labels and food-safety officer's guidance.

Basmati rice.storage: Airtight bin on a raised rack, cool and dry.
Basmati rice.recipe_hint: Jeera rice or veg pulao special

Sona masoori rice.storage: Airtight bin on a raised rack, cool and dry.
Sona masoori rice.recipe_hint: Lemon rice or tamarind rice special

Wheat flour.storage: Sealed container, away from moisture; watch for weevils.

Onion.storage: Dry, airy crate away from potatoes. Cut onion: covered, in the fridge.

Tomato.storage: Single layer in a cool crate; move ripe ones to the fridge.

Potato.storage: Dark, dry sack away from onions. Peeled potato: in water, fridge.

Mixed vegetables.storage: Fridge crisper at 4-8 °C; keep cut veg covered.

Green chilli.storage: Remove stems, store in a paper-lined box in the fridge.

Ginger-garlic paste.storage: Refrigerate after opening; always use a clean, dry spoon.

Coriander & mint.storage: Wrap in a damp cloth, fridge; do not wash until use.

Curd.storage: Fridge at 0-4 °C, lid on; never back into the fridge after service.

Milk.storage: Fridge at 0-4 °C; boil once opened pouches are used.

Cooking oil.storage: Closed can, away from the stove and sunlight.

Ghee.storage: Closed tin, cool place, clean dry ladle only.

Biryani masala.storage: Airtight, away from steam and heat.

Sambar powder.storage: Airtight, away from steam and heat.
